```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "knitr")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop("Missing package(s): ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

## User-editable settings -------------------------------------------------
scamp_data_path <- "MB_PPi_data_combined.csv"
output_dir <- "Results/Threshold_validation"
target_length <- 1000
fixed_columns <- 4
alpha <- 0.05

quantiles_to_test <- c(0.50, 0.60, 0.70)
mad_multipliers_to_test <- c(2, 3, 4)
reference_quantile <- 0.60
reference_multiplier <- 3

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

genotype_labels <- c("2_het" = "abcc6a+/-", "3_mut" = "abcc6a-/-")
treatment_levels <- c("_-PPi_-MB", "_-PPi_+MB", "_+PPi_-MB", "_+PPi_+MB")
treatment_labels <- c("-MB -PPi", "+MB -PPi", "-MB +PPi", "+MB +PPi")
```

# Aim

This notebook validates the dataset-wide positive-fluorescence threshold used in
the main analysis. It tests all nine combinations of low-tail quantiles (50%,
60%, 70%) and MAD multipliers (2, 3, 4). The original 60% + 3 MAD rule is the
reference. Only the threshold-dependent endpoints are evaluated:

1. positive area (% of pixels above threshold), and
2. mean positive fluorescence (mean intensity among pixels above threshold).

The analysis checks whether genotype/treatment conclusions are stable across
reasonable threshold choices. It does not validate the threshold against an
external ground truth.

# Helper functions

```{r helpers}
normalize_row <- function(row, target_length = 1000) {
  row <- as.numeric(row)
  row <- row[is.finite(row)]
  if (length(row) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, target_length))
  if (length(row) == 1) return(rep(row, target_length))
  approx(
    x = seq_along(row), y = row,
    xout = seq(1, length(row), length.out = target_length), rule = 2
  )$y
}

normalize_dataframe <- function(df, target_length = 1000, fixed_columns = 4) {
  if (ncol(df) <= fixed_columns) stop("No pixel columns were found.")
  fixed_data <- df[, seq_len(fixed_columns), drop = FALSE]
  variable_data <- df[, (fixed_columns + 1):ncol(df), drop = FALSE]
  normalized_data <- variable_data |>
    apply(1, normalize_row, target_length = target_length) |>
    t() |>
    as.data.frame()
  colnames(normalized_data) <- paste0("V", seq_len(target_length))
  cbind(fixed_data, normalized_data)
}

estimate_threshold <- function(pixel_matrix, background_quantile, multiplier) {
  values <- as.numeric(pixel_matrix)
  values <- values[is.finite(values) & values >= 0]
  if (length(values) == 0) stop("No finite, non-negative pixel values found.")
  cutoff <- unname(quantile(values, background_quantile, na.rm = TRUE))
  background <- values[values <= cutoff]
  baseline <- median(background, na.rm = TRUE)
  noise_mad <- mad(background, constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(
    background_quantile = background_quantile,
    multiplier = multiplier,
    low_tail_cutoff = cutoff,
    baseline = baseline,
    noise_mad = noise_mad,
    threshold = baseline + multiplier * noise_mad,
    scenario = sprintf("Q%02d_MAD%d", round(100 * background_quantile), multiplier),
    is_reference = background_quantile == reference_quantile &
      multiplier == reference_multiplier
  )
}

safe_welch_p <- function(value, group) {
  keep <- is.finite(value) & !is.na(group)
  value <- value[keep]
  group <- droplevels(factor(group[keep]))
  if (nlevels(group) != 2 || any(table(group) < 2)) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(t.test(value ~ group, var.equal = FALSE)$p.value,
           error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

safe_anova <- function(data, metric) {
  df <- data |> filter(is.finite(.data[[metric]]))
  if (nrow(df) == 0 || n_distinct(df$genotype) < 2 ||
      n_distinct(df$treatment) < 2) return(tibble())
  fit <- tryCatch(
    aov(reformulate("genotype * treatment", response = metric), data = df),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble())
  as.data.frame(summary(fit)[[1]]) |>
    rownames_to_column("term") |>
    transmute(term = trimws(term), p_value = `Pr(>F)`)
}

sign_class <- function(x, tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)) {
  case_when(is.na(x) ~ NA_character_, x > tolerance ~ "positive",
            x < -tolerance ~ "negative", TRUE ~ "zero")
}
```

# Load and normalize the SCAMP profiles

```{r load-data}
if (!file.exists(scamp_data_path)) stop("SCAMP input not found: ", scamp_data_path)
scamp_raw <- read.csv2(scamp_data_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
if (ncol(scamp_raw) <= fixed_columns) stop("Expected four metadata columns followed by pixel columns.")

scamp_norm <- normalize_dataframe(scamp_raw, target_length, fixed_columns)
pixel_data <- as.matrix(scamp_norm[, (fixed_columns + 1):ncol(scamp_norm)])
storage.mode(pixel_data) <- "numeric"

sample_info <- tibble(
  sample_id = as.character(scamp_norm[[1]]),
  treatment_raw = as.character(scamp_norm[[2]]),
  genotype_raw = as.character(scamp_norm[[4]]),
  genotype = factor(genotype_raw, levels = names(genotype_labels),
                    labels = unname(genotype_labels)),
  treatment = factor(treatment_raw, levels = treatment_levels,
                     labels = treatment_labels)
)

if (anyNA(sample_info$genotype) || anyNA(sample_info$treatment)) {
  warning("Samples with unrecognized genotype/treatment labels are excluded from inference.")
}

kable(sample_info |> count(genotype, treatment, .drop = FALSE),
      caption = "Sample counts by group")
```

# Threshold grid

```{r threshold-grid}
threshold_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
  background_quantile = quantiles_to_test,
  multiplier = mad_multipliers_to_test
) |>
  pmap_dfr(~ estimate_threshold(pixel_data, ..1, ..2))

if (sum(threshold_grid$is_reference) != 1) stop("Reference threshold is not unique.")

write.csv2(threshold_grid, file.path(output_dir, "threshold_grid.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(threshold_grid, digits = 3, caption = "Thresholds under all sensitivity scenarios")
```

```{r threshold-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
ggplot(threshold_grid,
       aes(factor(multiplier), threshold, colour = factor(background_quantile))) +
  geom_line(aes(group = background_quantile)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = is_reference), size = 3) +
  scale_colour_brewer(
    palette = "Dark2",
    labels = function(x) paste0(as.numeric(as.character(x)) * 100, "%")
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 8)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "MAD multiplier", y = "Positive threshold (a.u.)",
       colour = "Low-tail quantile", shape = "Reference")
```

# Recalculate threshold-dependent endpoints

```{r metrics}
metric_long <- threshold_grid |>
  select(scenario, background_quantile, multiplier, threshold, is_reference) |>
  pmap_dfr(function(scenario, background_quantile, multiplier, threshold,
                    is_reference) {
    positive_area <- apply(pixel_data, 1, function(x) {
      valid <- is.finite(x)
      if (!any(valid)) return(NA_real_)
      mean(x[valid] > threshold) * 100
    })
    mean_positive <- apply(pixel_data, 1, function(x) {
      x <- x[is.finite(x) & x > threshold]
      if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(x)
    })
    bind_cols(sample_info, tibble(
      scenario, background_quantile, multiplier, threshold, is_reference,
      positive_area,
      mean_positive_fluorescence = mean_positive
    ))
  }) |>
  filter(!is.na(genotype), !is.na(treatment))

write.csv2(metric_long,
           file.path(output_dir, "threshold_metrics_per_sample.csv"),
           row.names = FALSE)
```

# Stability of biological conclusions

For each endpoint and threshold, the notebook repeats only the inferential tests
needed to judge sensitivity: the genotype, treatment, and interaction terms of
the same two-way ANOVA, plus genotype contrasts within each treatment (Welch
tests with BH correction across treatments). Stability is assessed against the
60% + 3 MAD reference using both effect direction and significance at the
pre-specified alpha level.

```{r inference}
metrics <- c("positive_area", "mean_positive_fluorescence")

anova_results <- metric_long |>
  group_by(scenario, background_quantile, multiplier, threshold, is_reference) |>
  group_modify(~ map_dfr(metrics, function(metric) {
    safe_anova(.x, metric) |> mutate(metric = metric, .before = 1)
  })) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(significant = !is.na(p_value) & p_value < alpha)

contrast_results <- metric_long |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(metrics), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(scenario, background_quantile, multiplier, threshold, is_reference,
           metric, treatment) |>
  summarise(
    mean_het = mean(value[genotype == genotype_labels[["2_het"]]], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mut = mean(value[genotype == genotype_labels[["3_mut"]]], na.rm = TRUE),
    effect_mut_minus_het = mean_mut - mean_het,
    p_raw = safe_welch_p(value, genotype),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) |>
  mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
         direction = sign_class(effect_mut_minus_het),
         significant = !is.na(p_adj_BH) & p_adj_BH < alpha) |>
  ungroup()

reference_anova <- anova_results |>
  filter(is_reference) |>
  select(metric, term, reference_p = p_value,
         reference_significant = significant)

anova_stability <- anova_results |>
  left_join(reference_anova, by = c("metric", "term")) |>
  mutate(same_significance = significant == reference_significant)

reference_contrasts <- contrast_results |>
  filter(is_reference) |>
  select(metric, treatment, reference_effect = effect_mut_minus_het,
         reference_direction = direction,
         reference_p_adj_BH = p_adj_BH,
         reference_significant = significant)

contrast_stability <- contrast_results |>
  left_join(reference_contrasts, by = c("metric", "treatment")) |>
  mutate(
    same_direction = direction == reference_direction,
    same_significance = significant == reference_significant,
    same_conclusion = same_direction & same_significance
  )

scenario_summary <- contrast_stability |>
  group_by(scenario, background_quantile, multiplier, threshold, metric) |>
  summarise(
    all_contrast_directions_stable = all(same_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    all_contrast_significance_stable = all(same_significance, na.rm = TRUE),
    all_contrast_conclusions_stable = all(same_conclusion, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    anova_stability |>
      group_by(scenario, metric) |>
      summarise(all_anova_significance_stable = all(same_significance, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("scenario", "metric")
  ) |>
  mutate(overall_stable = all_contrast_conclusions_stable &
           all_anova_significance_stable)

write.csv2(anova_stability, file.path(output_dir, "anova_stability.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv2(contrast_stability, file.path(output_dir, "genotype_contrast_stability.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv2(scenario_summary, file.path(output_dir, "scenario_stability_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

kable(scenario_summary, digits = 3,
      caption = "Conclusion stability relative to 60% + 3 MAD")
```

# Effect-size overview

```{r effect-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
ggplot(contrast_stability,
       aes(factor(multiplier), effect_mut_minus_het,
           colour = factor(background_quantile), group = background_quantile)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(shape = significant), size = 2.5) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ treatment, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_brewer(
    palette = "Dark2",
    labels = function(x) paste0(as.numeric(as.character(x)) * 100, "%")
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "MAD multiplier", y = "Mutant minus heterozygote mean",
       colour = "Low-tail quantile", shape = "BH-adjusted p < alpha")
```

# Agreement with the reference endpoint values

```{r agreement}
reference_values <- metric_long |>
  filter(is_reference) |>
  select(sample_id, genotype, treatment, all_of(metrics)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(metrics), names_to = "metric", values_to = "reference_value")

metric_agreement <- metric_long |>
  select(sample_id, genotype, treatment, scenario, background_quantile,
         multiplier, threshold, all_of(metrics)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(metrics), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  left_join(reference_values,
            by = c("sample_id", "genotype", "treatment", "metric")) |>
  group_by(scenario, background_quantile, multiplier, threshold, metric) |>
  summarise(
    n_complete = sum(complete.cases(value, reference_value)),
    spearman_rho = if (n_complete >= 3)
      cor(value, reference_value, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs") else NA_real_,
    median_absolute_change = median(abs(value - reference_value), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv2(metric_agreement, file.path(output_dir, "metric_agreement_with_reference.csv"),
           row.names = FALSE)
kable(metric_agreement, digits = 3,
      caption = "Per-sample agreement with the reference threshold")
```

# Interpretation guardrail

```{r interpretation, results='asis'}
non_reference <- scenario_summary |> filter(scenario != "Q60_MAD3")
fully_stable <- nrow(non_reference) > 0 && all(non_reference$overall_stable)

if (fully_stable) {
  cat("Across all tested alternative thresholds, the directions of the within-treatment genotype contrasts and the significance classifications of both the contrasts and two-way ANOVA terms matched the 60% + 3 MAD reference. This supports the statement that the principal genotype and treatment conclusions were stable within the tested sensitivity range.\n")
} else {
  cat("At least one conclusion changed under an alternative threshold. Inspect `scenario_stability_summary.csv`, `anova_stability.csv`, and `genotype_contrast_stability.csv`; a blanket claim of threshold robustness is not supported.\n")
}
```

# Important limitation

All thresholds above are estimated from the complete current cohort. Therefore,
they can change if genotype/treatment group proportions change. Threshold-based
values from separate experiments are not automatically comparable unless the
threshold estimation strategy is harmonized or independently calibrated.

sessionInfo()
